tagline.en: EE MVNO — £5/month Starter Max 12 (7GB) on a 12-month contract
tagline.zh: EE虚商——5英镑/月的12个月合约套餐（7GB）

description.en: TalkHome Mobile is an EE MVNO owned by Nowtel Distribution. The headline £5/7GB 'Starter Max 12' is £5 per month on a 12-month contract (£60/year) — not a one-off purchase with 12-month validity. A true 30-day PAYG route exists at £5 (Starter, 4GB). Prices on 12-month plans are fixed until 2027.
description.zh: TalkHome Mobile是Nowtel Distribution旗下的EE虚商。主打的 5 英镑 7GB「Starter Max 12」是 12 个月合约的月费（一年合计 60 英镑），并非一次买断自带 12 个月有效期；也有 5 英镑/30 天的 PAYG 路线（Starter，4GB）。12 个月合约价格锁定至 2027 年。

details.en:
TalkHome's headline offer is the Starter Max 12: £5 per month for 7GB on a 12-month contract (£60/year) — despite the '12' in the name it is billed every 30 days, not a one-off purchase with 12-month validity. It runs EE's 2G–5G infrastructure, prices are fixed until 2027, and a genuine 30-day PAYG route (Starter, 4GB for £5) exists for avoiding contracts. No-usage/disconnection terms are not published on official pages.

The trade-off is direction: like other budget MVNOs reviewed alongside it, it is not designed as a mainland-China roaming card — the 7GB is UK-local, so cloud residents using it primarily from China are paying for data they cannot roam cheaply. For a UK number you will actually use in the UK on a cheap monthly bundle, it is a fuss-free option reviewed; for China-roaming-first needs, giffgaff/CTExcel/CMLink fit better.
details.zh:
TalkHome 的主打产品是 Starter Max 12：12 个月合约、每月 5 英镑含 7GB（一年合计 60 英镑）——名字里的「12」指合约期，实际每 30 天扣一次费，并非一次买断自带 12 个月有效期。它走 EE 的 2G–5G 网络设施，12 个月合约价格锁定至 2027 年；不想签合约的话也有真正的 30 天 PAYG 路线（Starter，5 英镑 4GB）。官方页面未公布不使用断号条款。

取舍在方向性：与同批盘点的低价虚商一样，它并非为中国大陆漫游设计——7GB 是英国本地流量，主要人在中国的云居民等于花钱买了无法便宜漫游的数据。

结论：如果你要的是「真会在英国用」的便宜月付英国号码，它算省事的选择；回国漫游优先，则 giffgaff/CTExcel/CMLink 更合适。

bestFor.en: UK residents wanting 7GB/month at £5 on a fixed-price 12-month contract.
bestFor.zh: 人在英国、想要每月5英镑7GB且价格锁定12个月的用户。
